## Description of Changes
Please include a concise summary of the changes and the motivation/context behind them.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally using `python main.py`.
- [ ] I have run automated tests with `pytest -v` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified that no memory leaks or deepcopy issues were introduced.
- [ ] I have added automated tests for new functionality if applicable.

## Screenshots and Demos (if applicable)
Please attach before/after screenshots or screen recordings of the UI behavior.
